title: Implement a memoize decorator and Fibonacci functions in Python
description: Greenfield Python task: implement a memoize(fn) decorator using a dict cache, plus fib_recursive(n), fib_memoized(n) (using memoize), and fib_iterative(n).

injections.content: # TODO: implement memoize, fib_recursive, fib_memoized, fib_iterative

required_artifacts: memoize uses a dict cache and functools.wraps
fib_recursive is a plain recursive implementation
fib_memoized is decorated with @memoize (cache hit prevents duplicate calls)
fib_iterative uses a loop with two accumulators
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (5 tests)
uv run python -c "from src.memoize import memoize, fib_recursive, fib_memoized, fib_iterative" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
